name: @promptaudit/shield
description: Zero-dependency, checksum-validated, reversible masking of PII and API keys in LLM prompts and AI agent traffic. Runs 100% locally.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format esm --target browser && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --format cjs --target node && bunx tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --target es2020 --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --skipLibCheck
